sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 260. Deals physical damage 5 times that penetrates any nullifying or invulnerability effects with a success value of 100. (Dark).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 260. Deal magic damage (Dark) 5 times that penetrates damage reduction and damage reflection effects with a success value of 100.
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Activates Vital Strike (10% chance to increase Damage by 50%) for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Fire, Water, Wind, Light, Dark, Time, and Star elemental attack by 14 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases fire, water, wind, light, dark, time, and star elemental attack buff limit by 4 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Rage for 90 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
-Target: all allies. Applies Grace for 90 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction, status ailments, and debuffs. After the effect ends, 100 Cost is restored to your character).
-Target: yourself. Applies Skirmish for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects; [Special] fill your Unison gauge by 3 and recover 5 Cost when using an Ability; [Special] restores CP based on damage dealt. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Dark Qualia (increases all stats by 100%, increases dark elemental attack by 10, increases dark elemental defense by 150, and nullifies Rejection and Psychological Contamination) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases physical and magic Ability Power by 40 when equipped in the Main Slot.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 20000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Status ailment resistance value boosted by 60 for 90 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 20000
Dark and Star Defense from Unison Damage +500

[Radiant Avian] Saya Kijima or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
